purpose: Pre-publication implementation and local verification record; not a production attestation
features: Shareable library query, kind and saved-only filters, including Back and reload
Preserve an unflushed query before opening a record; handle IME and stale asynchronous navigation
Tab-session return from a record to the original search or library card with focus and scroll restoration
Keyboard-accessible full-page search results without changing quick-search combobox navigation
Current-section menu visibility and keyboard focus restoration without moving the underlying page
Unambiguous source download explanation and non-duplicated 404 recovery links
Settle WebKit's observed post-bookmark fragment adjustment at the same offset, once after an own bookmark DOM commit

coordination.method: Normal merges preserving the four other chats' changes; dirty owner checkout not edited

preserved: Owner prose, names, source data and intentional duplicate entries
Rider long-press selection and vertical page scrolling

No public gallery upload or title edit during verification

repositoryGates.productionBuild: passed without running local database migrations

webkitFixBoundaries: Only own bookmark commits on hash-bearing library pages; cold hydration and unrelated renders do not scroll
Same x/y coordinates, no history, focus, pointer-default or pointer-capture change
Shared rail, load-gate, press feedback and root scroll CSS remain unchanged

No app workaround was added for this harness behavior.

Saved-only shelf, removal focus, reload and touch/mouse filter activation

Quoted and handwritten numeric library URL round trips
No horizontal overflow; download/404 recovery and current-location menu row
